question: Which size-matched distribution of customer-support experience produces the greatest held-out task improvement under a common learning and evaluation contract?

partitions.development: training-side tasks and trajectories used for source validation, starting-agent measurement, and candidate construction

candidate size, membership, and deterministic tie breaking

measure development experience without held-out outcomes
serialize candidate memberships, predictions, uncertainty, and abstention
build every candidate learning artifact under the matched operator and budget
evaluate every candidate on all required held-out tasks and repeats
open candidate outcomes only after completeness and identity checks pass
